name: Card Barrier
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 6, sorcerer/wizard 6, witch 6

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as house of cards but any enemy passing within 10 feet of the wall takes 4d6 points of slashing damage + 1 point per caster level (maximum +20.)

In addition, any creature that takes damage must make a Fortitude save or be take an additional 1d6 bleed damage.
